summary: GitHub collaboration data for one or more repositories: pull requests with their changed files, reviews and review comments, issues and comments, labels, milestones, releases, branches, workflow and check runs, users and organisations. Built from the actions of the fabric GitHub connector plus the extra pulls Actron needs for review history and CI results. Commits are not modelled here: they come from the local git clone (code.json) and are joined by SHA. Links from GitHub nodes to code nodes (Commit, File, Function) and to people are defined in core.json. Every node also carries the shared metadata defined in core.json (source, sourceUrl, ingestedAt, ontologyVersion, deleted).
use_cases: Which pull requests changed this file or function, and why?
What did reviewers argue about in this pull request, line by line?
Which issue or ticket did this pull request close?
Which CI checks passed or failed on the head commit of this pull request?
Who reviews changes to this area of the code most often?
